short_explanation: This week, the school is practising the sign for “more” during simple daily routines. You can use it at home when your child wants more of an activity, object or food that is already part of the moment.
when_to_use: During snack time when offering another piece or portion.
During play when continuing an activity your child is enjoying.
During shared routines where the word “more” naturally fits.
practice_tip: Say “more” clearly while modelling the approved sign from the school reference. Keep the moment short and natural.
school_home_connection: Use the same approved sign that is being introduced at school so the routine feels familiar across both settings.
boundaries: This is a family practice prompt, not a developmental assessment.
The message does not claim that Baby Sign accelerates language development.
Movement should follow the approved school reference rather than this text alone.
